blocks.text: 🪝 NITI Aayog Releases Bioeconomy Roadmap 2035: Targets  Billion Bioeconomy by 2035. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Recommends ₹50,000-crore BioEconomy Growth Fund across 6 National BioMissions.
Bioeconomy Targets: Projects growth from .3B (2025) to  by 2035 and .6 trillion by 2047 (8-10% of  GDP).
6 National BioMissions: GeneIndia, AgriBio 2.0, BioX Foundry, One Health Grid, Marine Biotechnology, BioPharmaNext.
Fund Allocation: Proposes ₹50,000-crore BioEconomy Growth Fund (2026-2035) to bridge lab-to-market commercialisation.
Bioeconomy 2035 target ( billion) vs 2047 target (.6 trillion).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on India composite score (71), top-performing states (Kerala, Uttarakhand), bottom state (Bihar), and 16 target SDGs.
